LIMITS, stated rather than worked around:
1. CELL TYPES DO NOT MATCH. Half-lives are HeLa/NIH3T3; burst kinetics are mouse
fibroblast mapped by uppercased symbol; the 252 knockdowns span 129 different human
cell lines. Every number above is a cross-cell-type comparison and no gate here
can separate a wrong model from a cell-type difference.
2. NO TIME COURSE. KnockTF records one harvest time, not reported per dataset, so
48 h is declared, not matched. The time sweep in K6 is the honest
substitute and it shows how much that choice moves the answer.
3. COLLECTRI IS LITERATURE-CURATED, so it inherits the fame structure this project
keeps finding. K5 measures it rather than assuming it away.
4. A SIGN IS NOT A RATE CONSTANT. Every edge gets unit weight because that is all
the annotation carries; beta and the 1/n_g buffering are assumptions, swept and
tested, not measured.
5. The absolute steady state is only predicted in ARM I, at 8.9x median
error. Nothing here claims the model reproduces a cell's mRNA levels.
